subject: 31 days in Proverbs, together
preview: A free community Bible study starts October 1. You are invited.

blocks.text: You have probably faced a decision this year where you honestly did not know what to do.
A job. A relationship. A conversation you kept putting off.
You did not need more opinions.
You needed wisdom.
God put a whole book in the Bible for exactly that.
Proverbs has 31 chapters.
October has 31 days.
One chapter a day fits perfectly.
So this Thursday, October 1, we are starting The Wisdom of Proverbs.
It is a free 31 day community Bible study inside Bible Buddy.
One chapter of Proverbs each day, all through October, studied together with Bible Buddies around the world.
Here is how each day works:
📖 Read or listen to that day's devotional
📜 Read the matching chapter of Proverbs
❓ Take the short trivia
💬 Answer the daily discussion question with the community
You do not have to show up at a certain time. A new day unlocks every day in October, and you can do it whenever it fits your schedule.
Miss a day? The days already unlocked stay open, so you can catch up.
Here is where wisdom starts.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
Wisdom does not start with being smart. It starts with knowing God.
And it grows best when you are not doing it alone.
You can sign up right now, and turn on a reminder so you know when each new day is ready.
